verdict.rationale: Unreal documents non-interactive command-line automation: commandlet cooking via `UnrealEditor.exe -run=cook`, the Unreal Automation Tool for testing and building, smoke tests that run when a commandlet starts, and Gauntlet test sessions. Headless operation is documented only for dedicated game servers, not for the editor or automation runs, and no doc frames these tools as CI-pipeline integration, so coverage is partial. Missing for 10: documented headless/unattended editor mode for automation (e.g. no-render flags), explicit CI-system integration guidance, independent or hands-on corroboration of CI usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
